name: Pat Riley
why: His own senior class portrait, and the only photograph of him the digitised volumes carry.
caption_quote: JAMES PATRICK RILEY, Bardstown. Kappa Sigma, pres; Junior Class V-P
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 141 (scan leaf n300). The left column lists seniors in alphabetical blocks of four and the photograph grid runs four to a row in the same order; the block Richardson / Riggins / Riley / Roberts matches row 1 as man, woman, man, man, so Riley is row 1, column 3. His printed entry names the Junior Class Vice Presidency and the Associated Students Judicial Congress, which is the office the worklist gives him for 1969-70.

name: Sue Pritchett
why: Her own senior class portrait; the only other frame of her is a small cheerleader picture.
caption_quote: PEGGY SUE PRITCHETT, Corydon ... Cheerleader ... Junior Class Secretary
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 158 (scan leaf n317). Names run down the left column in alphabetical blocks of four against a four-wide photograph grid in the same order; the block Pritchett / Pruett / Pugh / Pushko matches row 5 as woman, woman, woman, man, so she is row 5, column 1. Her printed entry ends Junior Class Secretary, the office the worklist gives her for 1969-70, and the volume index carries only one Pritchett, Peggy Sue.

name: Terry Hicks
why: His senior class portrait, the only photograph of him the digitised volumes carry.
caption_quote: TERRY M. HICKS, Bowling Green. History. Sophomore Class V-Pres.; Lambda Chi Alpha; IFC.
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 173 (scan leaf n332). Alphabetical blocks of four in the right-hand column run against a four-wide photograph grid in the same order; the block Hendricks / Hendricks / Hensley / Hicks matches row 7 as woman, man, woman, man, so he is row 7, column 4. The printed cell gives Bowling Green and Sophomore Class V-Pres. Both match the contemporaneous roster of the first Congress of Associated Students, which lists him as Terry Hicks, Sophomore, Bowling Green, Sophomore Class Vice President. The volume index carries exactly one Terry Hicks (Hicks, Terry Moss, 114, 173).
